annotations.title: Get where the workspace's mail lands

description: Get where the workspace's mail lands, and what our rules have slowed or stopped. Send `days`: 7, 14 or 30, today included, on the workspace's calendar. Left out, 7. Four parts. `placement`: warmup, by sending domain and receiving provider. Each provider row counts the emails that `arrived`, the ones the partner found in `spam` (part of `arrived`), the ones that `neverArrived`, the ones your mailbox's server refused (`bounced`), the ones still `tooSoon` to judge and the ones we keep out (`leftOut`), which add up to `sent`. `atTestInboxes` is how many of the arrived emails reached a test inbox we run. `fromOurServers`: what receiving servers answered about email that left our servers, by `stream` (`cold` or `transactional`) and provider. Accepted means the server took the email, not that it reached the inbox. `noWordYet` counts emails with no answer yet. It is null when the workspace has no agent inbox or sender address and sent nothing from our servers in the window. `attention`: the mailboxes and campaigns one of our rules paused or slowed, each with its reason, what the reason stops (`sending`, `first_contact`, `campaigns`, `warmup`, `nothing_yet`, `slows_warmup`) and when it began and ends. A person's own pause is not listed. It holds 100 items at most, and `more` counts the rest. `days`: one entry for each day with the emails sent, bounced and reported as spam, and the warmup sent, found and found in spam. There is no score. A share is `{ pct, of, bound }`, and `bound` is `under1` or `over99` when the figure is close to 0 or 100 but not exactly. A share shows only from 20 warmup emails (`placement.floor`) or 50 messages (`floor`); under that you get `{ tooFew, floor }`. Spam reports are a count and never a share, because most providers send none: `source` false means a provider that tells the sender nothing, which is not 0. A key limited to some mailboxes answers 403 `keyReads`.

days.description: How many days to read, today included, on the workspace's calendar: 7, 14 or 30. Left out, 7.
